features: TOUCHES DATABASE DATA, WITHOUT CHANGING THE SCHEMA: A MIGRATION REWRITES THE CREDIT SENTENCE OF THE REMINDER AND REALIGNS THE REMINDERS OF THE MIXED CASE WRITTEN BEFORE THIS BETA — The migration works only on the instalment reminders that the owner sees in the portal, and does three things. Where the description still contains, exactly, the 1.8.0 sentence that promised the automatic offset of the credit on the following instalments, it replaces that sentence and leaves the rest of the text as it is: in its place «il credito resta a tuo favore. L'amministratore può usarlo per compensare una tua quota da pagare o restituirtelo.» (the credit stays in your favour. The administrator can use it to offset one of your shares to pay or give it back to you.), or «il credito è stato usato o restituito.» (the credit has been used or refunded.) if the person has credit shares on that instalment that are not cancelled and they are all already paid in full. Then it recalculates, with the same calculation the program uses from this beta, the reminders written before that carry the reference to the instalment, for a single person who has on the instalment active shares of both signs, one to pay and one in credit (the mixed case), settled ones included: a report by the person stays as it is and the figures are updated, and the text is rewritten only if it is still the one written by the program. Finally it writes in the log how many reminders already settled still have a share to pay, without touching them. It does not change the schema, the dates or the other events, and in the reminders outside the mixed case it does not change the descriptions without the exact sentence, the states and the amounts, which are rewritten at the first movement on the instalment. It updates only the description and the data of the reminder, without touching `updated_at`: paid reminders do not reappear in the portal for thirty days. Every rewritten reminder goes into the application log, and one that cannot be realigned goes there as a warning, without stopping the update. It can be run again: the old sentence is no longer there and a realigned reminder is not recalculated a second time, so the second run changes nothing of what the first one wrote, and only retries a reminder it had not managed to realign. Without a migration, the reminders written from now on also save the cash paid by the person and how much is awaiting the offset, and the record of a usufruct transfer marks as income the income item it moves to «Usufruttuario» (usufructuary); a transfer recorded earlier reads as before. The income item outside the transfers. Income items, such as the rent of an antenna, were treated as expenses by the program in some operations without saying so: «Sposta spesa» (move expense) between an expense and an income, an invoice or an immediate adjustment on an income, a negative amount written instead of the type «Entrata» (income), ten totals that added income to expenses. The first three were in the «Not yet» of beta.51, which of the ten totals named only the badge «Disallineato: ricalcola!» (misaligned: recalculate!). With them the portal reminder for a credit share, which promised an offset that the program does not do by itself. The sign of an item is now read as the share calculation reads it, which does not change. There are also art. 984 of the Civil Code for income on units under usufruct and three fixes to the transfers: two to sentences and one to the Wallet selector. Every defect first had a red test; the fixes went through an adversarial review, two rounds of checks on the fixes and an on-screen check. The defects found in the new functions are fixed before release and do not appear among the fixes, which only concern what was already there.

CHANGED: «SPOSTA SPESA» (MOVE EXPENSE) ONLY WORKS BETWEEN ITEMS OF THE SAME TYPE — With «General expenses» at € 1,200.00 and the income «Antenna rent» at € 240.00 the plan asks for € 960.00. Moving € 50.00 from the expense to the income brought it to € 860.00, and the other way to € 1,060.00: the total changed by double the amount moved, with the success message. Now a move between an expense and an income is refused before writing, under «Sposta su» (move to): ««General expenses» è una spesa e «Antenna rent» è un'entrata: il budget si sposta solo fra voci dello stesso tipo, altrimenti il totale del piano cambierebbe. Scegli una voce dello stesso tipo.» (General expenses is an expense and Antenna rent is an income: the budget only moves between items of the same type, otherwise the plan total would change. Choose an item of the same type.) The destination menu offers only the items of the source's type, and a destination chosen earlier is cleared if it is no longer allowed with the new source. The type is the one with which the calculation distributes the item: a chapter of type «Spesa (uscita)» (expense (outgoing)) without its own tables and with only income sub-accounts counts as an income (moving € 100.00 to it from an expense took the plan from € 1,200.00 to € 1,000.00), and a chapter with expense and income sub-accounts together is neither moved nor receives (the move took the plan from € 1,400.00 to € 1,320.00): in the source menu it appears disabled, with «(capitolo con spese ed entrate: non si sposta)» (chapter with expenses and income: not moved). The reversal of a move already written does not go through this check. It was there since v1.9.0.

CHANGED: «SPOSTA SPESA» (MOVE EXPENSE) DOES NOT OVERLAP AN ITEM WITH A CHAPTER OR WITH SUB-ACCOUNTS ALREADY IN THE PLAN — In the plan «General expenses» at € 1,200.00 and the sub-accounts «Lift» (€ 600.00) and «Boiler» (€ 400.00) of the chapter «Maintenance»: € 2,200.00. Moving € 100.00 to «Maintenance» wrote a row for the chapter, and the calculation, which gives the chapter's share to the sub-accounts and skips their rows, counted only that one: the plan dropped to € 1,200.00 and «Ricalcola» (recalculate) answered with success. Now the move is refused: ««Maintenance» non è nel piano, ma lo sono i suoi sottoconti «Lift» e «Boiler»: con una riga anche per il capitolo il piano conterebbe solo quella e non più le righe dei sottoconti. Sposta il budget su uno dei sottoconti.» (Maintenance is not in the plan, but its sub-accounts Lift and Boiler are: with a row for the chapter too the plan would count only that one and no longer the rows of the sub-accounts. Move the budget to one of the sub-accounts.); towards a sub-account whose chapter is in the plan the sentence says to move the budget to the chapter, and the menu no longer offers these items. The overlap follows the calculation's rule: a chapter with its own thousandths tables does not pass the share to the sub-accounts, and the sub-accounts that count are those created up to the creation of the plan, or all of them if none was. In plans that the old move had already hit, the refusal says how to get out, and the page shows a box (among the new functions). This check does not apply to the reversal either. It was there since v1.9.0.

CHANGED: THE CHAPTER OF AN INVOICE IS AN EXPENSE ITEM — An invoice of € 300.00 recorded on the income «Antenna rent» (€ 240.00) created an overrun of € 60.00, and the supplementary plan that recovered it credited € 30.00 each instead of asking for them. Now the recording does not offer income items, the item proposed from the supplier's last invoice is only an expense item of the condominium, and the server refuses on the row's field: ««Antenna rent» è una voce di entrata: il capitolo di una fattura è una voce di spesa. Scegli un'altra voce.» (Antenna rent is an income item: the chapter of an invoice is an expense item. Choose another item.) When editing an invoice already written on an income, the row shows the item, which in the menu is disabled and marked «Entrata» (income), and saving is refused until the row goes to an expense item, even if you do not touch it: «Questa riga è sulla voce di entrata «Antenna rent»: il capitolo di una fattura è una voce di spesa. Scegli una voce di spesa per salvare la modifica.» (This row is on the income item Antenna rent: the chapter of an invoice is an expense item. Choose an expense item to save the change.) The supplier's credit note, the rows with the unit (the chapter is discarded), those at € 0.00 and the contingency ones stay as before; a negative row is refused like a positive one, and the reversal of an invoice already written on an income goes through. It was there since v1.9.0.

CHANGED: THE IMMEDIATE ADJUSTMENT IS NOT USED FOR AN INCOME — An adjustment of € 300.00 on an income wrote a cost in DEBIT and the cash in CREDIT: a bank outflow that did not exist. Now the chapter menu offers only expense items and the server refuses on the chapter's field: ««Antenna rent» è una voce di entrata: la regolazione immediata registra un'uscita di cassa e non si usa per un'entrata. Scegli una voce di spesa.» (Antenna rent is an income item: the immediate adjustment records a cash outflow and is not used for an income. Choose an expense item.) The reversal of an adjustment already written goes through. It was there since v1.10.0.

CHANGED: THE AMOUNT OF AN ITEM IS WRITTEN WITHOUT THE SIGN — An expense item written as minus € 240.00, instead of with the type «Entrata» (income), is charged positive by the calculation: next to «General expenses» at € 1,200.00 the plan asked for € 1,440.00 instead of € 960.00. Now in the new item the field does not accept the minus («-240,00» stays «240,00») and below it says «Si scrive senza il segno: lo decide il tipo della voce.» (it is written without the sign: the item's type decides it.); the server refuses a negative amount with «Una voce di spesa non può avere un importo negativo. Se è un provento, per esempio l'affitto di un'antenna, scegli «Entrata» e scrivi l'importo senza il segno.» (an expense item cannot have a negative amount. If it is revenue, for example the rent of an antenna, choose Entrata and write the amount without the sign.) or, for an income, «L'importo di una voce di entrata si scrive senza il segno: è il tipo «Entrata» a ridurre quanto si chiede ai condòmini.» (the amount of an income item is written without the sign: it is the type Entrata that reduces what is asked of the owners.) When editing, an amount changed to negative is refused, with the same text (before, for an item in no plan, the answer was «L'importo minimo consentito è € 0,00 (già impegnato nei piani rate)» (the minimum allowed amount is € 0.00 (already committed in instalment plans))): an item already negative, data from past versions, can be renamed and brought to «Income» without touching the amount, but a negative income is not brought to «Expense (outgoing)» without correcting the amount. When creating the plan the amount chosen for an item cannot be negative («L'importo di una voce nel piano non può essere negativo. Scrivi l'importo senza il segno: lo decide il tipo della voce.» (the amount of an item in the plan cannot be negative. Write the amount without the sign: the item's type decides it.)), and the refusal shows next to «Salva piano rate» (save instalment plan). A chapter written with the minus is created at zero, as before. It was there since v1.7.0; in the plan configuration since v1.9.0.

CHANGED: A PLAN WITH A NEGATIVE EXPENSE ITEM STOPS BEFORE WRITING — A plan with an expense item at minus € 240.00 was recalculated silently asking for € 1,440.00 instead of € 960.00. Now these stop before writing: the creation of the plan (even without generating it at once), the generation, «Ricalcola» (recalculate), «Sincronizza» (synchronise) and «Rimuovi voce e ricalcola» (remove item and recalculate), even when a positive item is removed while another one is negative (the item stays in the plan). The message at the top of the page names the item, the figure charged and the way out with its cost: «Il piano non si ricalcola: la voce di spesa «Refund» ha un importo negativo (meno € 240,00) e il piano la addebiterebbe in positivo, per € 240,00. Correggi l'importo della voce nel piano dei conti: se è un provento, scegli «Entrata» e scrivi l'importo senza il segno. Il piano tiene una copia dell'importo della voce e correggere la voce non la cambia: togli la voce dal piano con «Rimuovi voce e ricalcola» e riaggiungila con «Sincronizza». Togliendola si perdono i suoi tratti di competenza, se ne ha: annotali prima e riscrivili ricreando il piano.» (The plan is not recalculated: the expense item Refund has a negative amount (minus € 240.00) and the plan would charge it positive, for € 240.00. Correct the amount of the item in the chart of accounts: if it is revenue, choose Entrata (income) and write the amount without the sign. The plan keeps a copy of the item's amount and correcting the item does not change it: remove the item from the plan with Rimuovi voce e ricalcola and add it back with Sincronizza. Removing it loses its accrual periods, if it has any: note them down first and write them again by recreating the plan.) An approved plan must first be brought back to draft, and the message warns that this resets the approval data, to be noted down first. With more negative items, with a sub-account (which «Sincronizza» does not add back) or with the copy of a chapter, the way out is to delete the plan and recreate it, and the message says what is lost: the manual split of the joint balances, the accrual periods of the items, the recurrence, the budget moves between items and the amounts chosen for the items. The stop also triggers for a negative expense sub-account under a chapter with a positive copy, if the sum of the sub-accounts stays positive, and for a chapter with a copy at zero or negative if at least one of its sub-accounts is negative, expense or income; with a negative copy also without one, if the calculation charges it positive. It does not trigger for an income item written with the minus outside such a chapter, because the calculation removes its sign, nor in extraordinary plans. In the example, the item corrected to € 200.00, removed and added back, brings the plan to € 1,400.00; brought to «Income» with € 240.00, to € 960.00. The data was possible since v1.7.0; the stop is new.

CHANGED: THE PORTAL REMINDER DOES NOT ASK FOR WHAT THE CREDIT COVERS — A person has on the same instalment a share to pay of € 50.00 and a credit of € 10.00 on another share: the net is € 40.00. After the € 40.00 paid, the instalment window said «Totale rata calcolato € 40,00 · Già versato − € 40,00 · Residuo da pagare € 10,00» (calculated instalment total € 40.00 · already paid − € 40.00 · remaining to pay € 10.00) and offered «Ho pagato l'intera rata tramite bonifico» (I paid the whole instalment by bank transfer). Now the calendar, the dashboard and the window say «In attesa della compensazione» (awaiting the offset) and «Non devi versare altro. L'amministratore deve ancora registrare la compensazione di € 10,00 fra una tua quota da pagare e un tuo credito.» (You do not need to pay anything else. The administrator still has to record the offset of € 10.00 between one of your shares to pay and one of your credits.), without buttons; after «Usa credito» (use credit) the instalment is settled and the amount already paid stays € 40.00. On an instalment not yet issued with the net at zero the label is «Da compensare» (to be offset), and the sentence says that the administrator records the offset after the issue. A report that arrives anyway on an instalment with nothing to pay is refused before writing, with «Su questa rata non resta niente da versare: la compensazione di € 10,00 la registra l'amministratore. Non devi fare altro.» (There is nothing left to pay on this instalment: the offset of € 10.00 is recorded by the administrator. You do not need to do anything else.) (without an offset, «Su questa rata non resta niente da versare. Non devi fare altro.» (There is nothing left to pay on this instalment. You do not need to do anything else.)), and the refusal shows in the window. A pure credit is «A credito» (in credit) as long as the credit is there; used or refunded, the window says «Il credito di questa rata è stato usato o restituito: non resta niente da versare né da ricevere.» (The credit of this instalment has been used or refunded: there is nothing left to pay or to receive.) «Già versato» (already paid) is the person's cash, without the credit used, and the rows «Credito usato altrove o restituito» (credit used elsewhere or refunded), «Credito applicato da un'altra quota» (credit applied from another share) and «Credito ancora a tuo favore» (credit still in your favour) make the column add up where needed. The red due-date box also appears with the net in credit if an amount is still to be paid, and the open window shows the current state when the page reloads. The reminder text, only in Italian as before, follows the same state: for a pure credit «Non è richiesto alcun pagamento: il credito resta a tuo favore. L'amministratore può usarlo per compensare una tua quota da pagare o restituirtelo.» (No payment is required: the credit stays in your favour. The administrator can use it to offset one of your shares to pay or give it back to you.); a text edited by hand is not rewritten. The sentence that promised the automatic offset was there since v1.8.0, the paid amount counted on the shares to pay only after a collection since v1.9.0.

CHANGED: A CANCELLED SHARE DOES NOT KEEP THE COLLECTION CHECK OPEN — A share to pay that was cancelled and never paid no longer counts either for the person's reminder or for the settled instalment: after a collection or its reversal, if the other shares to pay of the instalment are paid, the collection check task closes, as the reminder says.

NEW: THE WARNING OF THE NEGATIVE EXPENSE ITEM ON THE PLAN PAGE — With issued instalments, collections, used credits or a transfer that settled it, a plan is not recalculated, does not lose items and is not deleted: the stop is reached only after cancelling everything, and until then the item stays charged positive without anyone saying so. Now the plan page shows, in every state and without buttons, a red box above the note on uncovered items: «Il piano contiene una voce di spesa con un importo negativo» (the plan contains an expense item with a negative amount), one sentence per item with the figure charged («La voce «Old refund» ha un importo negativo (meno € 240,00) e il piano la addebita in positivo, per € 240,00.» (The item Old refund has a negative amount (minus € 240.00) and the plan charges it positive, for € 240.00.)), the situation and the possible ways out, all of them, without choosing one. In draft «Ricalcola» (recalculate) stops; when approved the plan must first be brought back to draft; with shares in the journal, collections, used credits or the settlement of a transfer, «Ricalcola», «Rimuovi voce e ricalcola» (remove item and recalculate) and «Elimina» (delete) refuse it, and the ways out are to cancel in the order that works and then correct, or a balance: «Se il piano non si può più riscrivere (incassi o crediti usati da tenere, o un passaggio di titolarità che l'ha conguagliato), regola la differenza con un saldo sulle unità, da «Saldi iniziali»: questo piano non lo legge più, entra nel prossimo piano della gestione che applica i saldi, o nell'esercizio dopo. Il Wallet tiene un saldo per persona, gestione, unità ed esercizio, senza contare quelli scritti da un passaggio: dove la persona ne ha già uno, si corregge quello, se nessun piano l'ha ancora assorbito o se il piano che l'ha assorbito si può ancora riscrivere; se l'ha già assorbito un piano che non si riscrive più, il Wallet non accetta né un secondo saldo né la correzione, e per quella persona la differenza va nell'esercizio dopo. Se il saldo è fra quelli da cui una successione ha calcolato l'arretrato agli eredi, il Wallet lo dice e indica la strada.» (If the plan can no longer be rewritten (collections or used credits to keep, or a transfer of ownership that settled it), settle the difference with a balance on the units, from Saldi iniziali (opening balances): this plan no longer reads it, it goes into the next plan of the management that applies balances, or into the following year. The Wallet keeps one balance per person, management, unit and year, not counting those written by a transfer: where the person already has one, that one is corrected, if no plan has absorbed it yet or if the plan that absorbed it can still be rewritten; if a plan that can no longer be rewritten has already absorbed it, the Wallet accepts neither a second balance nor the correction, and for that person the difference goes into the following year. If the balance is among those from which a succession calculated the arrears passed to the heirs, the Wallet says so and shows the way.) The totals row of the page counts the item as the calculation does, positive (with «General expenses» at € 1,200.00 and the income «Antenna rent» at € 240.00, «da ripartire: € 1.200,00 (spese € 1.440,00, entrate € 240,00)» (to be apportioned: € 1,200.00 (expenses € 1,440.00, income € 240.00))). The bin stays enabled: it is the way out.

NEW: THE BOX OF THE OVERLAPPING ROWS — Where a chapter has its row in the plan together with those of its sub-accounts, as the old «Sposta spesa» (move expense) could leave it, the calculation counts only the chapter's row, and the sum of the rows is not the one apportioned. The plan page says so in an amber box: «Nel piano un capitolo ha la sua riga insieme a quelle dei suoi sottoconti» (in the plan a chapter has its row together with those of its sub-accounts), one sentence per chapter, «La somma delle righe non è quella che il piano ripartisce: «Ricalcola» non lo corregge, e «Sposta spesa» non offre queste voci come destinazione.» (The sum of the rows is not what the plan apportions: Ricalcola (recalculate) does not correct it, and Sposta spesa does not offer these items as a destination.), and the way out: remove the chapter from the plan with «Rimuovi voce e ricalcola» (remove item and recalculate) and, if the chapter received budget with «Sposta spesa», first reverse that move from the history, with the clock icon next to the amount. In the «Maintenance» example the reversal and the removal of the chapter bring the plan back to € 2,200.00.

NEW: THE WARNING OF THE CHAPTER WITH THE COPY AT ZERO OR NEGATIVE — Where no item is negative any more but a chapter has in the plan a copy at zero or negative and sub-accounts with amounts, for example after correcting the sub-account that the stop named, «Ricalcola» (recalculate) goes through and the chapter stays as it was. The page says so: «Il piano contiene un capitolo con la copia a zero o negativa» (the plan contains a chapter with the copy at zero or negative), one sentence per chapter that states the copy and the sub-accounts («… il piano ripartisce la copia fra i sottoconti, non i loro importi.» (… the plan apportions the copy among the sub-accounts, not their amounts.)), ««Ricalcola» non segnala questo capitolo e non ne cambia la copia: se è la cifra che volevi, non c'è niente da correggere.» (Ricalcola does not flag this chapter and does not change its copy: if it is the figure you wanted, there is nothing to correct.), and the way out: delete the plan and recreate it, with what is lost. It does not appear if the copy comes from a budget move that started from the chapter, nor for a chapter with its own tables, with a positive copy, with sub-accounts all at zero or created after the plan. For example, with an expense of € 1,200.00 and in the plan the chapter «Antenna» at zero, with the sub-accounts «Antenna maintenance» at € 100.00 and «Antenna rent», an income, written at minus € 500.00: the stop names the rent; corrected to € 500.00, «Ricalcola» goes through and the plan stays at € 1,200.00, and recreating it brings the total to € 800.00.

NEW: ART. 984 OF THE CIVIL CODE IN THE INCOME ITEM DIALOGS — Choosing «Entrata» (income) in the new item, when editing an item that sits on a single table and when linking to a table, a note appears: «Rent or a fee collected by the condominium is a civil fruit and belongs to the usufructuary (art. 984 of the Italian Civil Code); if the title of the usufruct says otherwise, that applies between the parties. On units under usufruct this entry decides: with «Usufructuary %» at 100 the income goes to the usufructuary, with «Owner %» at 100 to the bare owner. With the usufructuary entered by hand on the unit's page, a mid-year start date does not split the income day by day, unless a usufruct row ends the day before; an end date does. «Registra passaggio» splits the days.» The program does not choose for you: a new item starts from «Owner %» at 100, and the calculation does not change. With Elsa as bare owner, Ugo as usufructuary, an expense of € 1,200.00 and a rent of € 240.00: with the rent on «Owner» Elsa pays € 960.00 and Ugo nothing; on «Usufructuary» Elsa pays € 1,200.00 and Ugo has € 240.00 in credit. With the rent on «Usufructuary» and the usufruct established through «Registra passaggio» (record transfer) on 1 May the rent follows the days: € 78.90 to the person who was owner for the 120 days before (240 × 120/365), € 161.10 to the usufructuary for the 245 after. The labels «Owner %», «Tenant %» and «Usufructuary %» of the new item and of the link are now translated, and the link says «Percentuale della voce attribuita a questa tabella» (percentage of the item assigned to this table) instead of «della spesa» (of the expense).

NEW: THE USUFRUCT ESTABLISHMENT PANEL SAYS WHEN AN ITEM IS AN INCOME — In the list of the items that pass from «Proprietario» (owner) to «Usufruttuario» (usufructuary) an income has the label «Entrata» (income) and, when ticked, the sentence «Se è un frutto civile, come un affitto o un canone, l'art. 984 c.c. lo dà all'usufruttuario (se il titolo dell'usufrutto dice altro, vale fra le parti): l'entrata passa all'«Usufruttuario». Togli la spunta se deve restare al nudo proprietario.» (If it is a civil fruit, such as a rent or a fee, art. 984 of the Civil Code gives it to the usufructuary (if the title of the usufruct says otherwise, that applies between the parties): the income passes to Usufruttuario. Untick it if it must stay with the bare owner.); for the other units under usufruct in the table the amount of the last plan is not shown, which for an income would be a credit with the minus.

NEW: THE SUMMARY OF REFUSALS WHEN EDITING AN INVOICE — At the top of the edit form there is the error summary, the same as in recording, brought into view and with the field's name («Conto addebito» (debit account), «Riga 2» (row 2), …); the error of the item and that of the unit can also be read under their menu, and disappear as soon as the field changes. The windows that already have their own message do not repeat it. Before, a refusal from the server without a field, or the one on the debit account, did not appear anywhere, and saving seemed to do nothing.

NEW: THE WALLET: «INTERO IMMOBILE» (WHOLE PROPERTY) AND THE REFUSAL IN THE DIALOG — In the «Aggiungi credito» (add credit) dialog, or the debit one, if the management already has a balance for the whole property the choice «Intero immobile» is disabled, with «Questa gestione ha già un saldo per l'intero immobile: modifica quello esistente.» (This management already has a balance for the whole property: edit the existing one.), and the dialog starts from «Soggetto specifico» (specific person); the rows written by a transfer do not take the place, as for the server. A refusal from the server, for example a second balance or an invalid amount, can be read in the dialog, which stays open: before, nothing was shown.

TOTALS, SENTENCES AND PRINTOUTS: THE TOTALS SUBTRACT INCOME FROM EXPENSES — Ten totals added income items as expenses. With «General expenses» at € 1,200.00 and «Antenna rent» at € 240.00, on a correct plan of € 960.00, the badge «Disallineato: ricalcola!» (misaligned: recalculate!) stayed lit (expected € 1,440.00 against € 960.00) and «Ricalcola» (recalculate) did not turn it off, the dashboard said «URGENTE» (urgent) and «Delta: +€ 480,00», the expense list «TOTALE PREVENTIVO € 1.440,00» (total budget) while the apportionment printouts said € 960.00, and the plan creation «Totale richiesto» (total requested) € 1,440.00. Now the chart of accounts says «Preventivo: € 1.200,00» (budget), the expenses only, with the badge «Entrate: € 240,00» (income) and the hint «Le entrate si sottraggono alle spese: da ripartire € 960,00.» (income is subtracted from expenses: to be apportioned € 960.00.), and the list of charts of accounts € 1,200.00 with «2 voci (1 di entrata)» (2 items, 1 of them income) and «Entrate € 240,00» (income). The PDF expense list says «TOTALE PREVENTIVO € 1.200,00», «ENTRATE € 240,00» (income) and «DA RIPARTIRE (spese meno entrate) € 960,00» (to be apportioned (expenses minus income)), shows the income in its row with «(entrata)» (income) and the minus, adds the grand total on the amount to be apportioned (€ 960.00 plus € 300.00 of contingencies make € 1,260.00) and closes with «Le entrate si sottraggono alle spese: il preventivo da ripartire fra i condòmini è la differenza.» (income is subtracted from expenses: the budget to be apportioned among the owners is the difference.) The instalment plan page says «2 voci incluse • da ripartire: € 960,00 (spese € 1.200,00, entrate € 240,00)» (2 items included • to be apportioned: € 960.00 (expenses € 1,200.00, income € 240.00)), marks the income «Entrata» (income) with «€ -240,00», and the badge is off. The list of instalment plans has the column «Da ripartire» (to be apportioned), formerly «Preventivo» (budget), with «spese € 1.200,00, entrate € 240,00» (expenses € 1,200.00, income € 240.00) below; for plans with expenses only the figure does not change, except for a negative expense item, which now counts as positive as in the calculation. The dashboard calls the box «Da ripartire» (€ 960.00), says «… al netto delle entrate di € 240,00 …» (… net of income of € 240.00 …), «Allineato» (aligned) and 100 %; with the net at zero or negative, for example with income only, it says 100 % if the plan does not ask for more than the net. The plan creation says «Da ripartire: € 960,00 (spese € 1.200,00, entrate € 240,00)» (to be apportioned: € 960.00 (expenses € 1,200.00, income € 240.00)) and marks the income in the item selector. An income written with the minus, data possible from 1.7.0 to 1.11.0-beta.51, counts for its absolute value in the dashboard, in the uncovered items and in the new plan selector, which does not offer it as an overrun to recover. Without income, except the name of the list column, the words stay those of before («Totale richiesto», «Fabbisogno Condiviso» (shared requirement), «totale preventivo» (total budget)) and the expense list is the one of before. The badge was there since v1.9.0, in today's form since v1.10.0; the expense list since v1.9.1.

TOTALS, SENTENCES AND PRINTOUTS: THE «DISALLINEATO» (MISALIGNED) BADGE WITH AN ADVANCE AND AN AMOUNT ALREADY PAID — An item of € 1,000.00, € 200.00 already paid and an advance of € 500.00: the plan asks for € 400.00, because it subtracts from the amount already paid the same half it asks of the item, while the badge's expected figure subtracted it all and said € 300.00. The badge was lit on a correct plan, and «Ricalcola» (recalculate) did not turn it off. Now the expected figure subtracts the amount already paid with the same fraction as the calculation, never a cent more than what was paid, and the badge is off also with an advance of a third and a balance of two thirds of € 1,200.00 with € 300.00 paid (€ 300.00 and € 600.00) and with a chapter's row and the amount already paid on the sub-accounts. An amount already paid recorded after the generation still lights the badge: the plan has to be recalculated. It was there since v1.10.0.

TOTALS, SENTENCES AND PRINTOUTS: THE SENTENCES OF USUFRUCT TRANSFERS WITH AN INCOME — The «Cosa cambierà» (what will change) panel of a usufruct transfer put income items under art. 1004 of the Civil Code, which concerns expenses. Now, where only income passes to «Usufruttuario» (usufructuary), the sentence does not cite art. 1004 of the Civil Code (without issued instalments it says «… l'usufruttuario è …: nei piani generati o ricalcolati dopo passano all'«Usufruttuario» le sole entrate.» (… the usufructuary is …: in the plans generated or recalculated afterwards only the income passes to Usufruttuario.)), and the history «… questa entrata è passata dal «Proprietario» all'«Usufruttuario».» (… this income passed from Proprietario (owner) to Usufruttuario.); in the history and in the cancellation warning the moved item is called income in brackets («Antenna rent (Ownership, Ordinary 2026, entrata)» (entrata: income)), and the sentences of the blocked items say «l'entrata di quella voce» (the income of that item), or «l'ordinaria o l'entrata di quelle voci» (the ordinary expenses or the income of those items), instead of the ordinary expenses.

TOTALS, SENTENCES AND PRINTOUTS: THE SENTENCES OF THE END OF A TENANT WHO ENTERED LATER — Beta.51 said «Con la fine della locazione di Luca i suoi giorni dal 18 aprile 2026 tornano a chi paga al posto dell'inquilino …» (with the end of Luca's lease his days from 18 April 2026 return to whoever pays in place of the tenant …), but the days after the end are not Luca's, and the history «… i giorni di Luca dal 1 dicembre 2026 tornano …» (… Luca's days from 1 December 2026 return …), with the word order wrong. Now the two panel sentences say «… i giorni dal 18 aprile 2026 tornano a chi paga al posto dell'inquilino …» (… the days from 18 April 2026 return to whoever pays in place of the tenant …), and the history «Con questa fine la parte verso Elsa … risale da € 30,58 a € 61,15 (gestione …): dal 1 dicembre 2026, finita la locazione di Luca, i giorni tornano a chi paga al posto dell'inquilino, da regolare a mano fra …» (with this end the part towards Elsa … rises again from € 30.58 to € 61.15 (management …): from 1 December 2026, once Luca's lease has ended, the days return to whoever pays in place of the tenant, to be settled by hand between …). The figures do not change, and no data needs correcting: the sentences are read from the record. The transfer guide says «i giorni che copriva» (the days he covered).

TOTALS, SENTENCES AND PRINTOUTS: THE WALLET RULE WITH ITS EXCEPTION, IN THE GUIDES AND IN THE SUCCESSION — Five points of the guides stated the Wallet rule, one balance per person, management, unit and year, without saying that those written by a transfer do not count: whoever had only the row of a settlement read «si regola fra le parti» (settled between the parties) where the panel offered them the Wallet. The succession warning said the same, where the rows of the arrears passed to the heirs were written precisely by a transfer. Now the opening balances guide says «… perché il Wallet accetta un solo saldo per persona, gestione, unità ed esercizio, senza contare quelli scritti da un passaggio: la riga di un conguaglio non occupa il posto, e la riga a mano si aggiunge accanto» (… because the Wallet accepts one balance per person, management, unit and year, not counting those written by a transfer: the row of a settlement does not take the place, and the manual row is added next to it), the transfer and instalment plan guides give the manual route to whoever does not already have, on that management, that unit and that year, a balance that was not written by a transfer, and the succession warning says «se nessuno ha già, su quella gestione, quell'unità e quell'esercizio, un saldo che non sia stato scritto da un passaggio, altrimenti la parte si regola fra le parti; se i saldi registrati sono già la parte di ognuno, dice che ci sono già e che non serve registrare altro» (if nobody already has, on that management, that unit and that year, a balance that was not written by a transfer, otherwise the part is settled between the parties; if the balances recorded are already each person's part, it says that they are already there and that nothing else needs recording). The sentences that the panel composes with the names were already true and stay. In the example, with the transfer's row already in the Wallet, Ugo and Elsa record their manual balance, a second manual balance of the same person is refused, and the following plan absorbs the rows added together: Ugo € 35.77 and Elsa € 319.75 as debit, Ines € 355.52 as credit. It was there since beta.50 in the guides, since beta.51 in the succession warning.

TOTALS, SENTENCES AND PRINTOUTS: THE CREDIT IN THE COLLECTION, AND THE CONFIRMATION OF THE BIN — In the collection screen the hint on the credit of a row made it seem that the credit was used by itself; now it says «Su questa riga c'è un credito che puoi usare con «Usa credito».» (there is a credit on this row that you can use with Usa credito (use credit).). The confirmation of «Rimuovi voce e ricalcola» (remove item and recalculate) adds «Se la voce ha dei tratti di competenza, con la rimozione si perdono: annotali prima, perché si riscrivono solo ricreando il piano.» (If the item has accrual periods, they are lost with the removal: note them down first, because they can only be written again by recreating the plan.)

FIXES — When editing an invoice a row accepted the item or the unit of another condominium, and the costs passed from one book to the other (€ 130.00 left the costs of the first condominium and entered those of the second); the debit account, and in recording the reserve fund, the debt and the source of a coverage and the thousandths table of a contingency, could belong to another condominium, and a list instead of the id showed «Array to string conversion» on screen with the text of the query. Now the item, the unit, the debit account, the reserve fund, the debt, the source of a coverage and the thousandths table are checked in the condominium of the page, each with its own message on the field («La voce scelta non appartiene a questo condominio.» (the chosen item does not belong to this condominium.), and likewise for the others); the reserve fund must be the ledger account of a cash box of type fund, and the source of a coverage for a contingency an expense item. These choices could not be made from the form: the refusal concerns hand-built requests. It is data integrity, not confidentiality, because instance and database belong to a single customer. Editing allowed it since v1.9.1. A list instead of the id in «Sposta spesa» (move expense) and in the immediate adjustment, possible only with a hand-built request, ended in a server error with the text of the exception: now it is an error on the field («La voce da cui spostare il budget non è valida: scegli una voce dal menu «Preleva da».» (the item to move the budget from is not valid: choose an item from the Preleva da (take from) menu.), «La voce su cui spostare il budget non è valida: scegli una voce dal menu «Sposta su».» (the item to move the budget to is not valid: choose an item from the Sposta su (move to) menu.)), and in the adjustment the same for management, year, chapter, cash box and supplier. The refund of a credit did not realign the person's reminder in the portal, which stayed as it was. Now collection, «Usa credito» (use credit), refund and their reversals go through the same calculation: with the net of € 40.00 paid and then the refund of the credit of € 10.00, € 10.00 remain to be paid and nothing to offset. If the entry touches only the credit, a reminder reported by the person stays reported and the figures are updated. The X of the messages covered the text of long messages, such as the stop of «Ricalcola» (recalculate): the variants of the box removed the space on the right reserved for the X (16 px instead of 40). Now the space is there, on all the pages that use the message box. It was there since 1.10.0-beta.17. In the Wallet, with «Soggetto specifico» (specific person), the person selector excluded whoever had only rows written by a transfer, and the manual route of the stops could not be taken from the interface, even though the server accepted it: in the guides' test condominium it offered only Luca, now also Ugo, Ines and Elsa. The rows written by a transfer do not take the place, as for the server. It was there since beta.31, which brought the settlement rows into the Wallet, and was visible since beta.50, which proposes that route.

ERRATUM TO BETA.50 AND BETA.51 — Five entries of the changelogs of beta.50 and beta.51 stated the Wallet rule without its exception: in beta.50 «The tenant who stays» («if neither of the two people already has a balance on that management, unit and year (the Wallet accepts a single row per person, management, unit and year)») and «The stop after «Write»» («only if neither of the two people of the row already has a balance on that management, unit and year»); in beta.51 «The end of a tenant's lease after a sale stops and asks for the tick» («if neither of the two people already has a balance on that management, unit and year»), «The generation gate names the deceased» («if someone already has a balance on that management and unit, the part is settled between the parties») and the «Not yet» («the Wallet keeps one per person, management, unit and year»). The rule is one balance per person, management, unit and year, not counting those written by a transfer: the rows that a transfer has written, such as the pair of a settlement or the arrears passed to the heirs, do not take the place. So the manual route is the manual balance from the Wallet also for whoever already has the row of a settlement, and «settled between the parties» applies only if one of the people already has a balance that a transfer did not write. The rest of those entries stays true, and so does what the «Not yet» of beta.51 said about income items.

THE GUIDES — The «dettaglio piano rate» (instalment plan detail) guide says that income items are counted with the minus, that «Sposta spesa» (move expense) works between items of the same type, that in extraordinary plans it does not work and is always refused, and what to do with a negative expense item (the stop, the box, the plan's copy, the sub-account, the accrual periods, the draft). The guide on apportionment with usufruct adds art. 984 of the Civil Code to the rules, a section on income (a rent, a fee) with the caution about usufruct entered by hand, and income in the transfer. The invoice recording guide says that income items do not appear and are refused, and that when editing a row on an income must be moved to an expense item; the immediate adjustment guide that the chapter is always an expense item; the guide on account operations the expense list with income; the collection guide that the portal shows the credit, and says that the administrator can use it or refund it if on the same instalment the person has nothing else to pay, otherwise that the administrator records the offset. The transfer, opening balances and instalment plan creation guides state the Wallet rule with its exception, and the transfer guide states the end of a tenant with «i giorni che copriva» (the days he covered); the guide at the top of the chart of accounts says that the budget counts expense items only.

NOT YET — With a plan of chosen items that leaves out an income the dashboard says 125 % (the plan asks for € 1,200.00 against € 960.00 to be apportioned), and the list of uncovered items still names the income. A chapter with expense and income sub-accounts is split by the calculation in proportion between the two: «Sposta spesa» (move expense) does not move it and the totals of the plan page, of the list of instalment plans and of the badge split it as the calculation does, but the fix to the calculation belongs to 1.12. Also in 1.12: «Sincronizza» (synchronise) of a chapter with a sub-account created after the plan, which charges the income as an expense (it was there since v1.9.0); the move from an overlapping source, which still goes through in plans of the form before 1.9 already hit by the old «Sposta spesa»; the change of type of an item that already has movements. In extraordinary plans «Sposta spesa» does not work and is always refused: the source menu lists the invoices, but the move looks for the source among the items, with the invoice's internal identifier, and the refusal does not say why: «The selected source id is invalid.» if no item of the condominium has that identifier, otherwise another refusal of the move, sometimes with the name of an unrelated item, or «La voce sorgente non è presente in questo piano rate.» (the source item is not in this instalment plan.). Nothing is moved. The stop has an accepted false positive, with an income whose income sub-accounts are written with the minus: in some cases it stops even where the calculation would distribute correctly, and the way out is to correct the amounts of the sub-accounts. Of the panel's sentences on ordinary expenses the transfer form shows only the first, since beta.41: the sentence on art. 984 of the Civil Code and the one on who receives an income in the other units of the table exist but do not reach the screen; the label «Entrata» (income) and the sentence under the item can be seen. The settlement sentence with a net income still says «all'usufruttuario, art. 1004 c.c.» (to the usufructuary, art. 1004 of the Civil Code). The reminders saved before this beta and not of the mixed case stay as they are until the first movement on the instalment: those «Instalment settled» with a share to pay (the migration counts them) and those that read the paid amount instead of the cash paid. A payment made by someone else on behalf of the person («Versato da» (paid by)) is counted by the portal as theirs. The reminder text is only in Italian, and the Spanish of the new texts is a copy of the English. The actual collection of an income from third parties, such as the antenna rent paid to the condominium, cannot be recorded yet: it comes with the statement of accounts. The declared limits of the transfers in beta.51 remain.
